styles.lectra: Ap3005 butchers style
trims: Oliver harvey woven british button label set into right side seam as worn. 4cm down from top edge.
Oliver harvey wash instructions set under OH woven label right side seam as worn / Wash - 65%recycled polyester/35% organic cotton/60 degree wash / tumble dry/ 2 dot iron/do not bleach / p dry clean
OH black non tangle tape cut at 39cm to make towel loop
mfg: Make neck strap. Fold in half and enclose raw edges. Edge stitch long edge to close seam.
Set bib facing and insert neck straps. Edge stitched side of neck strap to be set to outside edge of bib and ensure good side of strap to topside.
Top of bib 6MM TOPSTITCHED.
Bib facing - Fold in 10mm to neaten lower edge. Edge stitch lower edge of facing which forms 5.5cm topstitching to front

Armhole double turned and topstitching to finish 6mm from edge. Cut towel loop at 39cm. Fold loop in half and set towel loop 17cm from cut edge of left side seam as worn. Stitch down towel loop to follow armhole stitching.
Hem - double turned and topstitching to finish 12mm from edge
Sides - double turned and topstitching to finish 12mm from edge. Insert waist tie. Insert labels right side as worn. Set 4cm down from top edge. OH woven label on top.
NOTE- Neaten armholes before side seam neatened
Fold waist tie back on itself to fall away from garment and edge stitch down to width of strap to secure.

Set neck strap to right side of bib as worn. edgestitching side of strap to be set to inside of neck as worn to reduce bulk. set strap to bib, box stitch strap and stitch x detail. position strap so edgestitching of base of strap end is in line with 3cm topstitching of bib.

Note apron to come back after eyelets set, to have waist ties set. set tie through eyelet 4cm and stitch down to secure. join to be on the inside as worn. boxstitch to 2 stitch wide to width of strap.
fin: Set rivets to top corners of all pockets.
Set eyelets. set centre of eyelet 3cm in from side seam and 3cm down from side seam.

Set studs to strap. female stud set to strap . set centrally to width and first stud 1.5cm from end then 4cm spacing- total 4 studs. (measurement from centre of stud) male stud set 1.5cm down and 1.5cm in from end of bib. second stud set 4cm spacing and 1.5cm in from edge of bib. vertically down.
Check , trim, press and fold. wrap in tissue, set product sticker and set into bag.
